integrity: Proof is analytic for all stated dimensions. The standalone checker independently examines finite conditional distributions only; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns Haar-uniform Euclidean directions for complete-bipartite symmetric edge polytopes at fixed total vertex count. A spherical-integral CDF representation is supplied rather than an elementary density. The distributional comparison is not asserted pointwise for fixed directions. Older equivalent statements under random-cut language remain a priority risk.
title: Balanced bipartitions stochastically enlarge Euclidean widths of symmetric edge polytopes
